subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should existing bundled skill frontmatter descriptions be expanded with concise trigger/WHEN wording now, or should this wait for a structured trigger metadata contract?
rationale: Current main still uses descriptions for skill selection, but OpenClaw docs also favor short one-line descriptions and a separate open issue proposes explicit trigger metadata; automation should not choose that public skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve concise description cleanup
options.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only update that keeps descriptions short while adding trigger-critical WHEN wording for remaining bundled skills.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Keep frontmatter descriptions compact and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the canonical place for exact trigger semantics.

options.title: Decline trigger expansion
options.body: Document that the current concise descriptions are intentional and close or redirect related partial PRs and duplicate audits.

recommendation.title: Approve concise description cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only update that keeps descriptions short while adding trigger-critical WHEN wording for remaining bundled skills.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal for bundled skill metadata and prompt policy decisions.
